- Acrylonitrile is known to be highly toxic and is classified as a probable human carcinogen. It can cause severe health effects if inhaled or absorbed through the skin.
- Divinyl benzene is primarily a cross-linking agent and is less toxic compared to some other monomers.
- Ethylene oxide is also highly toxic and is used mainly as a sterilizing agent and precursor in the production of other chemicals. It is considered a probable human carcinogen and poses significant health risks.
- Styrene is toxic but is generally considered less hazardous than acrylonitrile and ethylene oxide.
